en: we'll make you any shoes you like.
Ah, you're
note: Mark can't recall the name; the player answers 'Yes, I am {NAME}.' (#396 variant).

en: This time you've come during
business hours, I see.
I would like some shoes made.
Why, certainly. We're shoemakers, after all,
Please wait a while until your shoes are done.
To make up for the wait, I'll make you
something you'll be happy with.
Hm? That's odd...
I don't think I'd gotten this far
with them, though...
I was just
looking at your shoes, as it happens.
Look how fine the work is here.
These are going to make very fine shoes.
Almost as if I hadn't made them myself.
note: Joke: the shoes are being finished overnight by someone else (elves, cf. #2891).

en: No, I'm joking, only joking.
Your shoes will be ready soon.
All that's left is the finishing.
So I'll just take a little nap
I've been waiting for you,
They're finished. Take a look.
You're more than satisfied, aren't you?
So it seems.
Ah, good, I'm so glad.
Next time, do come to our home.
Not as a shop customer, but as a guest
of our home, you'll be most welcome.
If you wear them daily, wherever you go,
there's no greater joy for a pair of shoes.
As long as you take proper care of them,
you can walk as far as you like in them.
The shop's closed right now.
I'm sorry. I seem to have woken you.
This is the shoemaker's, isn't it?
That's right.
I have to keep making shoes night and day,
so I'm always sleepy.
The shop's closed right now.
So right now I'm taking a little nap
Care to stay and nap with me?
Good of you to come. Make yourself at home.
Or how about a little doze with me?
Ha ha ha, just kidding.
You seem pretty busy, after all.
But you'd best sleep while you can.
So, really staying for a doze?
Oh, were you asleep? I'm sorry.
No, no, it's fine.
I got so bored I was just nodding off
a little, that's all.
Ah, no, no. That's not it.
I don't mean I'm idle 'cause my shop's
not doing any business, mind you.
Look at these shoes. Great work, eh?
Mind you, at this level of work, I can never
make the same pair twice. That's its one flaw.
So, what about you?
What shoes shall Mark here make you?
Sorry, not yet
Ah, I see.
That's alright. Until you trust my skill,
you can't order with peace of mind, eh?
After all, shoes are partners that go
everywhere with you. Watch my work till
you're satisfied, then place your order.
Huh? Didn't I meet you in a dream?
Or was I awake that time?
Hello. I'm afraid I don't remember
meeting you in a dream.
Ah. I'm Mark.
I see. That's alright. Until you trust my
skill, you can hardly go placing orders
carelessly, can you?
How about it? Good work, eh?
Hwaah... Oh, it's you. Welcome.
Oh? These shoes
Ah, of course.
note: Leading space: follows #2877 + '...' on the same line.

en: My, they're very well made.
